instruction: Speak in Spanish. Deliver this with a building sense of urgency, starting slow and methodical, and getting faster and faster until the end.
text: Primero, tienes que entender el concepto básico, que es fundamental. Luego, aplicas la fórmula a los datos que te hemos dado. A partir de ahí, los cálculos se vuelven más sencillos y puedes resolver el resto del problema con mucha más agilidad.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio starts slow and methodical as requested, but fails to build a sense of urgency or significantly increase its speed towards the end. The delivery remains mostly flat and slow throughout.

instruction_evidence.speed_progression: The beginning is suitably slow, but the requested transition to a fast pace is barely noticeable.
instruction_evidence.urgency: There is no audible building sense of urgency; the tone remains measured and calm.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not evaluated due to instruction-following level < 3.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not evaluated due to instruction-following level < 3.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Start off speaking quietly with a worried tone, but build in volume and intensity, ending in an angry shout.
text: Les expliqué la situación una y otra vez, pero parecía que no me escuchaban. Repetí todos los detalles, les mostré los documentos, y aun así no hicieron nada. ¡Es increíble que después de todo eso, todavía me digan que es mi culpa!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to realize the requested progression. It starts at a normal volume rather than quietly, lacks a worried tone, and does not build up to an angry shout at the end (the delivery remains relatively flat and the end is cut off).

instruction_evidence.volume_progression: The speaker maintains a relatively consistent, normal volume throughout, failing to start quietly or end in a loud shout.
instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: The tone is mostly neutral or slightly annoyed from the beginning, without a clear shift from worried to angry.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. I want you to begin with an unnaturally high-pitched voice, then transition smoothly down to your normal vocal range by the end of the sentence.
text: ¡Ay, qué susto! Pensé que algo malo había pasado. Pero no, ya veo que estás bien. Menos mal. Vamos a sentarnos un momento, y me cuentas qué ha sucedido con tranquilidad.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio begins with a slightly higher pitch, but it is not 'unnaturally high', and the transition is abrupt rather than smooth, immediately dropping to a normal range after the first exclamation.

instruction_evidence.initial_pitch: The pitch at the beginning is elevated for the exclamation but not unnaturally high as requested.
instruction_evidence.pitch_transition: The transition is abrupt rather than smooth; the pitch drops to a normal range immediately after the first sentence instead of gradually transitioning throughout the text.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. As you read this, I want your emotion to change. Begin neutrally, then transition to surprise, and finally to joy.
text: Recibí una nota de la oficina central, dice que revise el anexo B. A ver... un momento... ¡No me lo puedo creer! ¡Me han concedido la beca para estudiar en el extranjero el próximo año!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to demonstrate the requested emotional progression. Instead of starting neutrally, transitioning to surprise, and ending in joy, the speaker maintains a loud, fast, and agitated tone throughout the entire recording.

instruction_evidence.neutral_start: The beginning is very fast and punchy, lacking a neutral tone.
instruction_evidence.transition_to_surprise: The middle section does not convey genuine surprise, continuing the same agitated delivery.
instruction_evidence.transition_to_joy: The final sentence lacks a joyful tone, sounding more like high-energy shouting rather than happiness.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin speaking with a hesitant, uncertain tone, but as you continue, your voice should become firm and decisive.
text: He estado pensando mucho en las opciones... y... bueno, no ha sido fácil. Pero después de considerarlo todo, he llegado a una conclusión. Me quedo aquí para terminar el proyecto.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly demonstrates the requested temporal progression, moving from a slow, hesitant start to a confident, firm resolution.

instruction_evidence.initial_hesitation: The speaker begins with a slow pace and deliberate pauses ('y... bueno'), effectively conveying uncertainty.
instruction_evidence.final_firmness: From 'Pero después...', the delivery becomes faster, stronger, and noticeably decisive, perfectly capturing the firm tone requested.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds natural, smooth, and human-like throughout the entire clip.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The shift in emotion is handled with excellent expressive nuance, making the progression feel genuine and impactful.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin this line in a very slow, very quiet manner. As you speak, build to a normal volume and speed, as if a thought is solidifying in your mind.
text: Parece que... la vida es una serie de puertas... y al final, no se trata de cuántas abrimos, sino de si tuvimos el coraje de cruzar el umbral de las más importantes.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio does not follow the requested progression. It starts and remains at a normal speed and normal volume throughout the entire utterance, failing to begin slowly and quietly.

instruction_evidence.speed: The speech rate is consistently normal from the beginning and does not exhibit a progression from very slow to normal.
instruction_evidence.volume: The volume is consistently normal from the start and lacks the requested progression from very quiet to normal.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following score.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following score.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin this line in a low-pitched, sad voice. Transition into a more neutral, pensive delivery with a normal pitch by the end.
text: Esa casa ya no está, la demolieron hace años. A veces me pregunto si los lugares guardan los ecos de las risas que una vez contuvieron.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to realize the requested dynamic progression. It does not start with a low-pitched, sad voice, and there is no audible transition; the delivery remains flat and relatively neutral throughout.

instruction_evidence.pitch_progression: The pitch is relatively uniform and normal throughout; there is no low pitch at the beginning.
instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: The voice sounds neutral and detached from the start, with no clear 'sad' emotion or transition to 'thoughtful'.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following score.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following score.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin this line slowly, as if you are begging. Then, your tone should become strong and defiant, and your speaking rate should get faster.
text: Te lo ruego, considera lo que te estoy diciendo, es importante para ambos. Pero si no quieres verlo, está bien. ¡Yo seguiré mi propio camino y demostraré que tengo razón!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speed progression from slow to fast is audible, but the emotional shift from pleading to defiant is largely flat and unconvincing.

instruction_evidence.speed_progression: The speaker starts slowly and increases the pace in the final sentence.
instruction_evidence.tone_progression: The emotional tone is mostly neutral throughout. The begging quality is absent at the beginning, and the defiant tone at the end is very weak.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech sounds quite synthetic and robotic, with unnatural pacing and pauses.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emotional delivery is flattened and lacks the requested rich expressiveness.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Deliver this line with a progression of emotions and volume: begin happy and normal, then become worried and quiet, and conclude fearful and very quiet.
text: ¡Qué bien, por fin llegamos a la cabaña! Es un poco más vieja de lo que recordaba, y la puerta está entreabierta. Un momento... creo que hay alguien adentro.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully begins happy and normal, and concludes fearful and quiet. However, the middle section fails to lower the volume to 'quiet' and lacks a strong 'worried' emotion, making the progression abrupt rather than a smooth three-stage transition.

instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: Starts happy and ends fearful, but the middle section sounds more neutral than worried.
instruction_evidence.volume_progression: Starts normal/loud, remains loud for the middle section, and then abruptly drops to quiet at the end. The middle stage is not quiet as requested.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your delivery needs three distinct phases. Phase one: quiet, slow, thoughtful. Phase two: a furious climax, very loud and very fast. Phase three: quiet, slow, sad resignation.
text: Uno intenta construir algo, pieza por pieza, con cuidado. ¡Y luego llegas tú y lo destruyes todo en un segundo sin pensarlo! Y yo... me quedo aquí, entre las ruinas.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The delivery is flattened and fails to follow the requested dynamic progression. The speed and volume remain fairly constant throughout, lacking the required quiet/slow beginning, loud/fast climax, and quiet/slow conclusion.

instruction_evidence.phase_one: The beginning is read at a moderately fast pace and normal volume, failing to sound quiet, slow, or thoughtful.
instruction_evidence.phase_two: There is a very slight increase in volume, but it falls far short of a furious climax that is very loud and very fast.
instruction_evidence.phase_three: The final sentence maintains a similar pace to the rest of the audio and lacks the quiet, slow, and sad resignation requested.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your tone should shift back and forth between sarcastic and complaining. Start sarcastic, then get whiny, and then return to sarcasm.
text: Me encanta trabajar en equipo, es lo mejor. Especialmente cuando soy el único que hace todo el trabajo. Es genial ver cómo los demás se relajan mientras yo paso la noche en vela. Pero claro, el mérito será para todos por igual, ¡qué justo! Ya estoy harto, ¿por qué siempre tengo que cargar con todo? Es increíble que a nadie más le importe.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The delivery is generally flat and robotic. There are only very weak hints of sarcasm and a slight increase in intensity for the complaining part, but the dynamic progression is largely flattened and the return to sarcasm is not clearly audible.

instruction_evidence.sarcastic_start: The initial sentences have a slight monotonous delivery that poorly attempts sarcasm.
instruction_evidence.whiny_complaining_middle: There is a minor shift in intensity during 'Ya estoy harto', but it lacks a true whiny or complaining quality.
instruction_evidence.sarcastic_end: The return to sarcasm is not clearly distinguishable from the rest of the flat delivery.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech sounds quite synthetic and robotic, lacking humanlike smoothness.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emotional delivery is flattened and lacks rich variation.
